system.notes:
Normal | Minion

An armed mercenary testing their luck.
Motives & Tactics: Charge, lacerate, overwhelm, profit

Difficulty: 10 | Thresholds: None | HP: 1 | Stress: 1

ATK: +3 | Weapon: Melee | 3 phy

Experience: Raider +2

Features

Minion (4 - Passive): The Sellsword is defeated by any damage. For every 4 damage a PC deals to a Sellsword, defeat one additional Minion within any range the same attack would have hit.

Group Attack - Action: Spend 1 Fear to choose a target and spotlight all Sellswords within Close range. Those Minions move into Melee with the target and make one shared attack roll. On a success, each deals 3 physical damage. Combine the damage.
